decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit based on the evidence provided.

evidence.text: Maintained the three-year roadmap for the fryer range at Castell Foodservice Equipment and wrote the specification for the 2023 high-efficiency fryer with the engineering team.
evidence.notes: Directly states roadmap and specification work.

evidence.text: Joined the quality engineers' corrective-action reviews on heating-element failures reported from the field in 2022; the reviews decided on a new element supplier and an added burn-in test.
evidence.notes: Shows collaboration with quality engineering on field failures.

evidence.text: Castell's former head of quality confirmed by email that the candidate attended the 2022 heating-element corrective-action reviews as the product representative.

the warranty report the candidate referred to was supplied directly by Castell's quality department. It shows heating-element warranty claims on the fryer range falling from 38 per 1,000 installed units in 2021 to 17 per 1,000 in 2023, using the same claim definition in both years.
evidence.notes: Provides quantitative reduction in warranty claims.

evidence.text: Prepared the technical response sections for two national restaurant-chain tenders and attended the product demonstrations with the sales team.
Visited 14 restaurant and catering kitchens to watch fryers in use during service, and wrote up each visit for the specification team.
evidence.notes: Shows customer requirement gathering via site visits.
